title: A weekend of building
description: The October hackathon in photographs.
caption:
Innovating tomorrow, one line of code at a time! 🚀💡

What an electrifying weekend at the Next Gen AI Institute hackathon! We witnessed brilliant minds turn complex problems into groundbreaking solutions.
A massive honor to have Dr. Raza Ahmed Khan (Dean, Nawab Shah Alam Khan) grace the event as our esteemed Chief Guest. His inspiring words reminded us why building for the future starts right here, right now. 🌟
A special round of applause goes out to our incredible solo participant who took home the grand cash prize of ₹3,000—proving that determination, grit, and brilliant execution need no team size! 🏆🔥

But let’s be real: a hackathon isn’t just about one winner; it’s about the spirit of creation. To every team of two and every single coder who pulled through until the end: Your ideas, sleepless hours, and hustle were the true heartbeat of this event. Every participant walked away as a winner by pushing their limits and building something extraordinary. 👏✨

Swipe through to catch the energy, the focus, and the unforgettable moments!

Drop a 💻 in the comments if you were part of the magic!
